notes.title: minor bug
notes.content: A bug was fixed, which caused the player to continue receiving damage when in contact with the king, while he was defeated.

notes.title: Lair of goblins official departure
notes.content:
Lair of goblins is now available in the store!
Now you can enjoy hitting those green skins and de-stress like you've never done before. Remembering your bosses, unbearable friends or that annoying brother-in-law while you play Lair of goblins.

notes.title: Long awaited release!
notes.content: October 11 of this same 2023, keep this date, since the launch of Lair of goblins for windows is scheduled.

notes.title: I keep working ...
notes.content:
I have added new zones or places, as well as enemies, among other things to the game.
I have also updated the Demo, so you can test for yourselves how these improvements are going.
Much less to go until the game comes out! how sure it will be this year, although I can't specify much more.

notes.title: Block at 58%.
notes.content:
Specifically, a bug that blocked loading at 58% on some computers was fixed. Now you can have fun hunting goblins and enjoy, like the rest, with this free demo.
